recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized 1970s airbrushed illustration featuring a large hand with cyan fingernails holding a fanned-out set of four 'Ace' playing cards. Each card contains a realistic portrait of a man. The composition is set against a vibrant cyan background with concentric rainbow arcs radiating from the center.
coreVisualRelationships: Hand as the central anchor holding the card fan
Portraits embedded within the suit-specific Ace cards
Rainbow arcs framing the central action and creating movement
Cyan background unifying the foreground elements
coreInvariants: High-contrast airbrushed shading on the hand

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large hand enters from the bottom left, scaled to occupy 60% of the frame, holding cards that fan across the upper half.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The hand's palm and the silver watch at the wrist serve as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the wrist upward to the hand, then fans out across the four cards, guided by the circular rainbow arcs.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open cyan space in the top corners and bottom right provides breathing room for typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Brown and Black (Hand and hair tones)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red, Yellow, Green (Rainbow arcs and card suits)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background and rainbow elements against warm, earthy skin tones.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy black drop shadow for depth

composition.position: Top left and top right corners

treatment.shadow: Hard black drop shadow offset bottom-right

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in different positions for symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 70s aesthetic and wide proportions.
Provides the necessary geometric clarity and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an airbrushed illustration on a cyan background. A large hand with brown skin and cyan fingernails enters from the bottom left, wearing a silver watch. The hand holds four fanned-out Ace playing cards (Hearts, Diamonds, Spades, Clubs). Each card features a realistic portrait of a man with 1970s styling. Add concentric rainbow arcs (red, yellow, green, blue) radiating from the center behind the cards.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top left and top right corners. Apply a thin black outline and a heavy black drop shadow to the text to ensure legibility against the cyan background.

verificationChecks: Ensure the rainbow arcs are soft-edged and concentric.
Check that the fingernail color matches the background cyan.
Verify the drop shadow on the text is hard-edged and consistent.
Confirm the hand shading uses smooth airbrush-style gradients.

adjustableVariables: Number of cards in the fan
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the portraits
Any existing logos or brand marks
postGenerationChecks: Does the hand look integrated with the cards?
Is the cyan background consistent in saturation?
Are the rainbow arcs properly centered behind the subject?
Is the typography legible with its drop shadow?
recipe.reuseFormula: Airbrushed Hand + Card Fan + Rainbow Arcs + Cyan Background + Geometric Shadowed Type
